meta.title: Bidding Scope Rule: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same tenant
Locate and use the Bidding Scope Rule to require all-line or allow partial bidding
Assert that the control is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer
Record tenant RBAC configuration when other roles are deliberately granted access
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same tenant; Locate and use the Bidding Scope Rule to require all-line or allow partial bidding; Assert that the control is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer; Record tenant RBAC configuration when other roles are deliberately granted access

steps.note: Open an existing event page where the tester can inspect the bidding configuration.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same tenant, locate Bidding Scope Rule, try requiring all-line or allowing partial bidding with each role, and compare whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: Role-specific sessions and the Bidding Scope Rule action are not expressible by catalog steps.
Assert that no generic application error was left on screen after the tester's comparison.
